---
title: "Overall survival — primary model fitting"
subtitle: "Bayesian proportional hazards model with a five-df M-spline baseline"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The unchanged SAP model is fitted independently to each of the 50 completed
datasets with four chains and 4,000 iterations.

```{r}
#| label: fit-os-models
#| include: false
library(rstanarm)

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)
imputation_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations.rds"
)
model_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
imputations <- readRDS(imputation_path)

for (index in indices) {
  output_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(output_path)) next

  completed_data <- mice::complete(imputations, index)
  assert_ecog_binary_consistent(completed_data)
  assert_mgps_consistent(completed_data)
  completed_data$mgps <- factor(completed_data$mgps, levels = 0:2)

  # One intervention participant was censored on the randomization day. They
  # remain in the imputed datasets and estimand population but cannot
  # contribute follow-up time to the survival-model likelihood.
  fitting_data <- completed_data |>
    dplyr::filter(survival_time_days > 0)
  model_formula <- survival::Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
    tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps
  fit <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = fitting_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = rstanarm::normal(
      location = rep(0, 6),
      scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 5))
    ),
    prior_intercept = rstanarm::normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = rstanarm::dirichlet(1),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "survival", index)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, output_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
